verdict.rationale: cubic has a dedicated memory-and-learning feature: during onboarding it analyzes experienced reviewers' historical PR comments and extracts learnings. Its AI wiki also automatically indexes the codebase and keeps that knowledge current in the repo, which gives it persistent context across reviews. However, the evidence only shows a one-time learning pass at onboarding. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent continuously builds memory from ongoing interactions, a description of how learnings are recalled in later sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
